data.fund_name: SBI US Specific Equity Active FoF
data.fund_type: An open-ended fund of funds scheme investing in actively managed overseas equity oriented schemes that invest in US markets
data.investment_objective: The scheme seeks to provide long term capital appreciation by investing in units of one or more actively managed overseas equity oriented schemes predominantly investing in US markets. However, there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme would be achieved.
data.benchmark: S&P 500 Index (after converting it to Indian Rupee)
data.exit_load: For exit on or before 1 year from the date of allotment – 1%. For exit after 1 year from the date of allotment – Nil
